That last part is the whole thing. Most vendors in this space post a purity number and expect you to take their word for it. We put the paperwork in the box.

2 · Who Buys

Three people. Most of your audience is the first one.

1. The one who already knows

Already in this world. Follows the space, knows the names, has probably bought before — maybe from somebody sketchy.

What they want: a vendor they don't have to worry about. What lands: proof, paperwork, lot numbers, "I've ordered here a bunch." What loses them: hype. They've seen it. They're immune.

2. The one who's curious

Been hearing about this for a year. Hasn't pulled the trigger. Doesn't know where to start or who to trust, and everything they've googled looks kind of shady.

What they want: somebody to just explain it and point them somewhere safe. What lands: plain language. "Here's what this actually is, here's where I get it." What loses them: jargon, or anything that feels like a pitch.

3. The one shopping on price

Knows the category, buying on value, comparing tabs.

What they want: to not get ripped off. What lands: real numbers. "Market's $45–64 on this. We're $46 and you get the paperwork." What loses them: dodging the price question.

The line that works on all three

"Lab tested, 99%+ pure, made in the USA, and the certificate comes in the box."

And the thing they all actually care about

Not being scammed. This category has burned a lot of people. Whatever angle you take, that's the anxiety underneath it.

3 · The Campaign

What we're doing

Getting elev8 in front of people who are already interested in this space, through creators they already trust. That's it.

Goal: first orders, and a batch of content we can learn from.

What you get

Your linkelev8labsrx.com/r/YOURCODE
Your codeYour followers save 5%
You earnCommission on everything through your link or code — see your agreement
Cookie90 days. Someone clicks today and buys in two months, you still get paid.
PayoutsEvery two weeks, $50 minimum

What we'd like from you

Nothing rigid. Rough shape:

  • 2 TikToks
  • 1 Reel
  • A few Story frames with the link sticker
  • Raw clips if you're happy to share them — we'd use them on our own channels

Vertical, 1080×1920, decent light, keep the important stuff out of the bottom third so the UI doesn't cover it. That's the only spec that matters.

Timing

Post whenever it fits your calendar during the campaign window. Send us the live link after.

If you want a second pair of eyes on something before it goes up, send it — we'll come back within a day. Not required.

Two things, and then we'll leave you alone

1. No dosing. Don't tell people how much to take or how to run it. You're not their prescriber — point them at the site and let the medical side of it handle that.

2. Disclose it. Toggle on, say it in the video, first line of the caption. This one's genuinely for your protection — the FTC can go after the creator directly, not just the brand. Takes four seconds.

That's the whole list.

TikTok, specifically

TikTok Shop's prohibited list names this product category outright, so we can't be a registered Shop seller — which means don't build content around showing the vial. Show the box, show the logo, say the name, send them to the link. The product renders in the asset pack are made for exactly this.

Music

Use the platform's commercial library — TikTok's Commercial Music Library, Instagram's Meta Sound Collection. Trending audio isn't licensed for sponsored posts, and if something takes off and we want to put money behind it, it has to be cleared audio from the start.

Who to talk to

support@elev8labsrx.com — anything at all.

5 · Quick Start

Sixty seconds. Then go make something.

1. Grab your stuff

  • Link: elev8labsrx.com/r/YOURCODE
  • Code: yours, gives your people 5% off
  • Assets: [download them here](https://ele8brandkit.vercel.app/assets/) — product shots, logos, ready-to-post templates

2. Know the pitch

Lab tested. 99%+ pure. Made in the USA. Certificate in every box.

Free shipping over $200. Ships in about a day.

3. Pick an angle

Ten that work in this space:

  1. "Where I get mine." Simple. Effective. Works every time.
  2. "How to not get scammed buying this stuff." The single best-performing angle in the category.
  3. "Why is everyone talking about this right now." Category explainer.
  4. "Comparing what I've ordered from five different places." Packaging, price, paperwork.
  5. "You're overpaying." Price breakdown.
  6. Unboxing. Box, label, paperwork. Show the box, not the vial.
  7. "Answering the question I get most." Reply video.
  8. "Things I wish I knew before I started looking into this."
  9. Reacting to somebody else's take on the category.
  10. Whatever your channel already does. Skit, rant, POV, trend. Your format wins over ours.

4. Two rules

No dosing. Not your job — send them to the site.

Disclose it. Toggle on + say it + first line of the caption. Protects you.

5. Post it, then send us the link

That's it.
